limitations: These are heuristic plain-LWE/SIS and quantum Core-SVP estimates, not full-profile quantum security.
Primal hybrid and dual search retain classical guessing; no quantum search optimization is included.
No module-specific, multi-target, or QROM security proof was run.
The stock tbox generator was not executed unchanged; the selected wrapper removes internal beta signs and uses exact pointwise range bounds.
Native Gaussian sampling and rejection probability precision remain unvalidated.
The pinned z2 bimodal rejection passes stdev1_squared rather than stdev2_squared and must be repaired.
The signed-message bimodal branch and whole-attempt restart adapter remain unimplemented.
Archive parameter runs retain superseded tbox and legacy norm metadata. They are not selected profile definitions.
Ten scalar evaluation repetitions require zeroing and checking both lanes 0 and 32; the pinned generic API only handles lane 0.
The binding estimates require the corrected full z2 norm and exact z1/hint acceptance bounds; unchanged native verification does not enforce them.
Version0.4 uses explicit uniform CRS; earlier public AES seed expansion had an unproved uniform-matrix security transfer.
The 130.8-bit challenge and query-dependent QROM losses do not establish128-bit quantum signature security; key-recovery target is separate.

validation.current_driver_changes: Input validation, exact integer coefficient bound, default ordinary mode and self-check certification corrections do not alter stored estimator inputs or costs.
